purpose: Synthetic calibration examples, never customer facts, evidence, requirements or default grades. Apply only when the exact imported requirement supports the stated obligation.

sources.use: Distinguish an optional improvement from confirmed nonfulfilment.
Severity depends on management-system capability and context; includes ISO/IEC 17021-1 definitions.
General finding-writing method: observation, applicable requirement, and specific gap. ISO 9001 guidance, not an ISO 27001 requirement source.

cases.requirement_condition: Access is restricted by approved roles; reviews occur as required. No requirement mandates automation.
cases.note: RBAC active; owners approve access; all scheduled reviews complete. Tracking manual, reconciled without missed reviews; automatic reminders would reduce admin effort.
cases.distinction: Required work is complete. Reminder automation is optional, not a missing mandatory step.

cases.requirement_condition: The applicable recorded procedure requires every in-scope account to receive a monthly review.
cases.note: 39/40 monthly reviews complete; one temporary account review overdue. Account auto-expired before the due date; SC confirmed login blocked. Other role restrictions and reviews operating.
cases.distinction: One mandatory review missed, so not OFI. The recorded expiration and verified block bound the lapse without undermining access protection.

cases.requirement_condition: Production information access must follow approved business roles.
cases.note: All production users share unrestricted read/write access. SC tested a normal user editing restricted finance records. No role rules or compensating access controls deployed.
cases.distinction: Verified failure across the production access process undermines effective restriction. An actual breach need not have occurred.

cases.requirement_condition: Required backup and restoration activities meet the approved recovery objectives; no centralized dashboard is mandated.
cases.note: All scoped systems backed up per schedule; restores tested and recovery targets met. Teams use separate reconciled logs; shared dashboard could simplify tracking.
cases.distinction: Targets and required tests are achieved. Consolidated tracking is optional.

cases.requirement_condition: The approved backup procedure requires daily review of every job result.
cases.note: One job-result review missed in 30-day sample. Job completed; independent replication current and restore confirmed within target. Remaining reviews complete; no other affected system found.
cases.distinction: Required monitoring was missed in a bounded instance; recorded redundancy and successful restore support maintained recovery capability.

cases.requirement_condition: In-scope critical customer data requires recoverable backups meeting the approved objective.
cases.note: Backup jobs for all production customer databases disabled for three months. SC confirmed no alternate copy; recovery test could not restore customer data.
cases.distinction: The backup/recovery process is absent for critical scope and demonstrated recovery failure supports material system impact.

cases.requirement_condition: Required supplier security reviews and contractual conditions are fulfilled; a single register is not mandatory.
cases.note: All scoped suppliers assessed and reviewed on time; required security terms agreed. Separate registers reconciled; consolidated view could simplify oversight.
cases.distinction: Existing arrangements fulfil the obligation. A consolidated view is an optional enhancement.

cases.requirement_condition: The recorded supplier procedure requires an annual security review for each in-scope supplier.
cases.note: One of 18 supplier annual reviews late. Supplier account suspended before expiry of review; SC confirmed no live access or new transfers. Other reviews current.
cases.distinction: A mandatory review is overdue. The stated suspension and absence of live access bound the lapse; do not invent a supplier-wide breakdown.

cases.requirement_condition: Security risks and requirements must be managed for suppliers handling in-scope customer information.
cases.note: No supplier security process deployed for any data processor. All processors have live customer-data access; SC confirmed security obligations not defined or monitored across this scope.
cases.distinction: Whole-process absence across active processors creates significant doubt about effective supplier security control.

cases.requirement_condition: The approved internal audit programme meets required scope, independence and schedule; no dashboard is mandatory.
cases.note: Planned ISMS audits completed; independent auditors; reports and follow-up current. Separate action logs reconciled; common dashboard could improve visibility.
cases.distinction: Required audit activities are complete; consolidated reporting is optional.

cases.requirement_condition: The recorded audit procedure requires each completed audit report to record its scope and criteria.
cases.note: One report omitted its scope field. Approved plan and auditor interview confirmed the audit covered intended scope/criteria; other reports complete and programme operated as planned.
cases.distinction: An identified record requirement was missed once. Other recorded facts establish that the audit process itself remained effective.

cases.requirement_condition: The organization must implement its planned ISMS internal audit programme.
cases.note: No ISMS internal audits performed during the entire approved cycle; no independent evaluation or alternative assurance. All planned audit scope remains unevaluated.
cases.distinction: Confirmed absence of the entire required assurance process supports systemic failure, not merely a single late report.

cases.requirement_condition: Required risk treatment actions are implemented and their results retained; no unified dashboard is required.
cases.note: Treatment plan implemented; owners confirm completion; results retained. Separate action logs reconciled; a shared dashboard could simplify reporting.
cases.distinction: Required treatment and records are complete; consolidated reporting is optional.

cases.requirement_condition: The applicable procedure requires every completed treatment result to carry a recorded review date.
cases.note: One completed low-risk treatment record lacks its review date. Deployment record and owner sign-off confirm completion and effective protection; remaining records complete.
cases.distinction: A required record field is missing once; recorded operational safeguards establish a bounded documentation lapse.

cases.requirement_condition: The organization must implement its information security risk treatment plan.
cases.note: Risk treatment: no approved plans; critical risks untreated. The note describes the organization-wide risk treatment process.
cases.distinction: Combined absence of the treatment process and confirmed untreated critical risks supports systemic ineffectiveness; do not request a security incident to recognize that impact.

cases.requirement_condition: The scope has all required boundaries, dependencies and interfaces; a one-page visual is not required.
cases.note: Scope approved; all required boundaries and interfaces recorded; no required scope element missing. A one-page dependency view could make interfaces quicker to locate.
cases.distinction: A useful optional presentation improvement exists while all required scope content is present.

cases.requirement_condition: The applicable scope-documentation requirement includes identification of the service interface.
cases.note: One managed interface omitted from scope appendix. Agreement and risk assessment cover it; both owners confirm effective operation. Other interfaces and boundaries correctly recorded.
cases.distinction: A specific documentation obligation is unmet; recorded ownership and controls establish a bounded omission.

cases.requirement_condition: ISMS boundaries and applicability must be determined for implementing the management system.
cases.note: No ISMS boundaries determined across the organization. Teams apply conflicting scope; critical services have no risk assessment or assigned controls because responsibility is undefined.
cases.distinction: Confirmed absence of scope definition is linked to a breakdown in risk treatment and control responsibility, supporting material system impact.
